brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.godDescription: Every hit crits (2x). Must attack each turn or take 20 damage. PARTY: allies gain +25% damage when you crit (inspired). TITAN: can solo titans — each crit cracks armor. CONTEST: the crowd chants your name; +50% fan gain.

shieldbearer.name: Shieldbearer
shieldbearer.godDescription: Redirect ALL ally damage to you. Store 300%. Unleash as army-wide AoE. Over 500 stored kills you too. PARTY: the wall that never breaks. TITAN: can block titan hits (store massive damage). CONTEST: the audience weeps; +100% reputation.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.godDescription: All attacks hit. Marked targets take 3x crits. PARTY: mark targets for allies (+50% their damage vs marked). TITAN: mark weak points (eyes, joints) for 5x. CONTEST: the perfect shot — instant win on accuracy challenges.

caregiver.name: Caregiver
caregiver.godDescription: Healing revives (once per fight per target). PARTY: the reason everyone survives. TITAN: keep the army alive through titan AoE. CONTEST: the mercy moment — sparing a foe wins the crowd.

drifter.name: Drifter
drifter.godDescription: Cannot be hit for 3 turns after moving 3+ tiles. PARTY: scout ahead, draw fire, reposition allies. TITAN: untouchable — can plant bombs on titan weak points. CONTEST: the ghost — win races/chases automatically.

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.godDescription: See all monster intents. Map fully revealed. PARTY: share intents (allies dodge +25%). TITAN: see the titan's next 3 moves. CONTEST: the knower — win trivia/strategy challenges.

socialite.name: Socialite
socialite.godDescription: All social actions crit. Crowd fights for you (summon 2d4 fans as allies). PARTY: inspire (+50% all stats for 3 turns). TITAN: turn the army's morale — they fight harder. CONTEST: you ARE the show — auto-win performance challenges.
socialite.scale: party morale, army inspiration, contest winner

survivalist.name: Survivalist
survivalist.godDescription: Never need food/water. All stats +50%. PARTY: share the bounty (allies also don't need food). TITAN: outlast the titan — it tires, you don't. CONTEST: the endurance — win survival challenges.

miser.name: Miser
miser.godDescription: All resources double. Can buy anything (even victory?). PARTY: equip everyone with the best. TITAN: buy titan-slaying weapons. CONTEST: the sponsor — bribe judges (risky but effective).

forager.name: Forager
forager.godDescription: All foraging yields 5x. Never fail. PARTY: feed the army. TITAN: find the titan's food source — poison it. CONTEST: the provider — win feast challenges.
